hero.tagline: I build scalable, high-quality web and mobile applications. Over 9 years of experience turning complex problems into clean, intuitive user interfaces, from real-time architectures to production AI integrations.

about.p1: I am a Frontend Engineer with 9 years of experience building scalable, high-quality web and mobile applications. I enjoy tackling complex problems and turning them into clean, intuitive user interfaces through thoughtful architecture and attention to detail.
about.p2: Driven by curiosity and a strong product mindset, I continuously refine my skills and embrace new technologies, from real-time architectures to AI-powered pipelines. Throughout my career I've collaborated with companies of different sizes, from startups to enterprise organizations, handling everything front-end: from component architecture to state management, API integrations to design systems.
about.p3: Great software is the result of solid engineering practices combined with a deep focus on user experience and long-term maintainability. Today I work as a freelancer, helping my clients turn their ideas into modern, high-performing interfaces — powered by AI where it counts.

items.description: Front-end consultant for companies of different sizes, focused on scalable architectures, real-time systems, and production AI integrations. Selected projects:

projects.name: Battlepip
projects.detail: Real-time trading app (PWA) with Server-Sent Events and an interactive dashboard built on TradingView Lightweight Charts.

projects.name: Geeks Creation
projects.detail: AI pipeline to extract structured data from images and populate a CRM, orchestrated with the Vercel AI SDK and an evaluation layer.

projects.name: Red Software
projects.detail: Complex management platform built from scratch with advanced workflows, role-based permissions, and map integrations.

projects.name: Mom
projects.detail: Accessible (WCAG) financial guidance portal for simulating and planning investments, from UX to user and subscription management.

projects.name: MeApp
projects.detail: Back-office applications and a cross-platform mobile app for a recycling startup, owned end to end.

projects.name: Crm Dematech Impianti
projects.detail: CRM for managing construction sites, project tracking, client relationships, and billing.

projects.name: Toduba
projects.detail: Refactored a Next.js/React codebase and introduced a unit and E2E testing strategy.

items.description: Developed new applications from scratch. Designed the entire user experience using Figma. Utilized Micro Frontend architecture with Module Federation for modular, scalable solutions. Developed a comprehensive testing suite for E2E and unit testing.

Developed software from scratch using Vue.js and TypeScript. Designed the entire user flow and graphical interface using Figma and Penpot. Contributed to the testing strategy by implementing E2E test coverage and unit testing.

Developed new frontend applications. Established frontend guidelines for external and internal collaborators and designed a corporate theme for Material UI to speed up the creation of new applications.
Developed and modified WPF applications. Utilized software tools for mapping source system data (XML, flat files, CSV, EDIFACT) to data warehouse tables.
